## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`cargo test --release`, relevant `tests/*.py`)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No new network calls, telemetry or external assets
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are permissively licensed and justified
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes
